name: – Ondřej Knotek – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on combating VAT fraud – the effectiveness of cross-border cooperation when it comes to VAT fraud and its impact on the EU budget
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for stronger EU action against cross-border VAT fraud, where traders collect tax and vanish before paying it. It wants the EU's anti-fraud bodies to share information better, get access to VAT databases, and receive more money and staff. It also asks the Commission to propose new laws on recovering fraud losses, on fraud in imports and online sales, and on protecting the EU's new carbon trading system from fraud. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose new laws and better cooperation.
- **Who it affects:** EU anti-fraud bodies, national tax and customs authorities, businesses, and the EU budget.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is expected to respond with a legislative package after its review of the EU's anti-fraud setup.
